project.name: Pronto quality and remediation
project.identity: The Pronto quality and remediation surface that consumes evidence without hiding uncertainty.
project.audience: Operators and agents deciding what quality or remediation work is safe and valuable next.
project.core_loop: Read quality evidence, explain findings and gates, select an authorized remediation path, and preserve the result.
project.north_star: Quality work is prioritized from explicit evidence and every blocked or degraded path remains visible.

scope.purpose: Turn quality evidence into explainable findings, governed remediation order, and reviewable handoffs.
scope.boundary: Owns quality, evidence-contract, remediation, and their renderer projections; repository inventory and external provider acquisition remain outside this child.

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The Pronto quality and remediation boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.
